name: artifacts
description: Documents, reports, pages, dashboards, diagrams, decks and small apps your agents make, kept on your server with every version, private unless you share one.

tools.name: artifacts.create
tools.summary: make an artifact (a doc, report, page, dashboard, diagram, deck or small app)

tools.name: artifacts.update
tools.summary: save a new version of an artifact

tools.name: artifacts.get
tools.summary: read an artifact, any version

tools.name: artifacts.list
tools.summary: list artifacts

tools.name: artifacts.search
tools.summary: find artifacts by the words in them

tools.name: artifacts.versions
tools.summary: an artifact's versions

tools.name: artifacts.diff
tools.summary: what changed between two versions

tools.name: artifacts.restore
tools.summary: go back to an earlier version, as a new version

tools.name: artifacts.move
tools.summary: move an artifact to another project

tools.name: artifacts.archive
tools.summary: archive or bring back an artifact

tools.name: artifacts.delete
tools.summary: delete an artifact, with 30 days to undo

tools.name: artifacts.undelete
tools.summary: bring back a deleted artifact

tools.name: artifacts.export
tools.summary: an artifact as one file to download

tools.name: artifacts.share
tools.summary: make a public link to an artifact

tools.name: artifacts.unshare
tools.summary: stop a public link

tools.name: artifacts.public.status
tools.summary: whether public links are on

tools.name: artifacts.public.set
tools.summary: turn public links on or off

tools.name: artifacts.public.base
tools.summary: the public address links use (network setup)

tools.name: artifacts.mention.search
tools.summary: the # picker's artifact results

tools.name: artifacts.mention.resolve
tools.summary: an artifact tagged with #, as a reference for the thread

tools.name: artifacts.activity.log
tools.summary: record that an interactive artifact navigated away

tools.name: artifacts.activity
tools.summary: what an interactive artifact has done: navigated away

tools.name: artifacts.media.gallery
tools.summary: generated images, video and audio as a gallery, newest first

tools.name: artifacts.media.usage
tools.summary: how much generated media is kept, and the limits

tools.name: artifacts.media.register
tools.summary: keep an image, video or sound a provider made, with its prompt and session

tools.name: artifacts.media.read
tools.summary: the bytes of a media artifact, in chunks, for Vyre's own surfaces

tools.name: artifacts.media.copy
tools.summary: put a media artifact in your own folder so you can open the file

tools.name: artifacts.capture.register
tools.summary: catch files a session saves in its artifacts folder
